mrblue: Hello! Why shout? You could have knocked.

links.name: Sorry — I wasn't sure anyone was home

passages.name: Что за шутка?
passages.text:
mrblue: We're a small community here — we don't love strangers much, and we value everyone minding their own business.
mrblue: We started calling each other by the colours our houses are painted. It began as a joke, then it stuck.
mrblue: By the way, we rented you this place because you're a redhead. Okay, only partly true. We really do like scientists here, especially professors and writers. And you're both a professor and a writer!

links.name: Yes — I'm planning to write a book

passages.name: Спасибо, я пожалуй пойду
passages.text: //return to map

Я и сам не знаю
passages.text: msgreen: Yes — sometimes lost souls end up here, with nowhere else to go. And it seems like a pretty good place. I see you're already ginger and living in the orange house. I think you'll fit into our little community, if you want.

passages.name: Написать книгу
passages.text: msgreen: Really? What's it about? A novel? A scholarly book? You look more like a lecturer than a belletrist.

links.name: I wanted to write a scholarly book, but I'm secretly thinking about a novel
links.link: Я сначала хотел написать научную книгу, но в душе думаю о романе

links.name: It will be a scholarly book about my theory
links.link: Это будет научная книга о моей теории

passages.name: Спасибо, но мне пора!
passages.text: //return to map

passages.name: Вы были врачом?
passages.text: msgreen: Yes — all my life, and now I'm retired. I still help out — I treat aches and give advice. After all, this is an island of old folks; people come here when they want quiet.

links.name: Yes — that's why I came too
links.link: Да, понимаю, я сюда приехал за этим же

passages.name: Да, понимаю, я сюда приехал за этим же
passages.text: msgreen: You'll certainly find peace here. Just don't get caught up in political games. You'd think eight people would be enough — yet grudges always turn up. What do you need the quiet for?

passages.name: Просто отдохнуть
passages.text: msgreen: Oh, there's more than enough rest here. But enough — that's plenty for a first meeting. We're almost all introverts. We'll see each other again; lovely to meet you!

passages.name: Я сначала хотел написать научную книгу, но в душе думаю о романе
passages.text: msgreen: I hope I'm among the first eight readers! But enough — that's plenty for a first meeting. We're almost all introverts. We'll see each other again; lovely to meet you!

passages.name: Это будет научная книга о моей теории
passages.text: msgreen: I hope I'm among the first eight readers! But enough — that's plenty for a first meeting. We're almost all introverts. We'll see each other again; lovely to meet you!

passages.name: Forrest
passages.text: What a pleasant road! Good for walking!

passages.name: Thicket
passages.text: A bit eerie. Woods, but very dark. You don't expect that on this island.

passages.name: Lighthouse
passages.text: A wonderful view of the ocean and the whole island!

passages.name: Bar
passages.text:
//in the bar mrred, msyellow, mrpurple

mrred: Sorry — we'd be glad to talk, but a little later; we have private business and would rather not be interrupted.

passages.name: Полюбоваться видом
passages.text:
You stand and gaze into the distance.
//appears mswhite
mswhite: (muttering) Why is there no quiet place anywhere!
mswhite: Hello — let's get acquainted! I think I heard you're a writer?

links.name: Almost — I came to write a book, but it's scholarly
links.link: Почти, я приехал написать книгу, но она научная

links.name: Yes — I'm going to write a novel

passages.name: Почти, я приехал написать книгу, но она научная
passages.text: mswhite: Oh? How interesting — I'm not a big fan of thick science books. I hope you're not writing a dictionary?

links.name: No — it's an account of my theory

passages.name: Да, я собираюсь написать роман
passages.text: mswhite: Interesting! I'm intrigued. But wait — don't tell me. Just promise you'll let me read at least the first chapter!

links.name: As soon as I've written it
It's very personal — I'm not ready yet

passages.name: Нет, это описание моей теории
passages.text: mswhite: (sighing) How interesting! But forgive me — you should go. I wanted to be alone, and since I've lived here longer than you, I'd be grateful if you left.

passages.name: Это было немного грубо
passages.text: mswhite: Perhaps you're in the wrong place at the wrong time. Let's talk later.

passages.name: lighthouse2
passages.text: mswhite: Oh — forgive me, you should go. I wanted to be alone, and since I've lived here longer than you, I'd be grateful if you left.

passages.name: Привет, Майк! Приятно познакомиться
passages.text:
mrred: Let me tell you a bit about our island. I'll bring you up to speed.
mrred: This is a place for people who want peace and quiet. You can enjoy your retirement, relax, or write a book. I heard you're planning to write one.

links.name: Yes — I brought everything I need to sail away in a year with a finished book
links.link: Да, взял все необходимое чтобы через год уплыть отсюда с написанной книгой

passages.name: Ничего себе, целый остров!
passages.text: mrred: Yes — I bought it many, many years ago with money from my old business. Now I'm retired; I just enjoy my old age and the company of wonderful people I rent to. They're friends more than tenants. I hope we'll become friends too.

passages.name: Обязательно
passages.text: mrred: Just go easy with that wish! This is an island for people who want peace and quiet. We don't pry into each other's affairs. You can enjoy your retirement, relax, or write a book. I heard you're planning to write one.

links.name: Yes — I brought everything I need to sail away in a year with a finished book
links.link: Да, взял все необходимое чтобы через год уплыть отсюда с написанной книгой

passages.name: Я бы хотел больше уединения
passages.text: mrred: Who wouldn't! This is an island for people who want peace and quiet. You can enjoy your retirement, relax, or write a book. I heard you're planning to write one.

links.name: Yes — I brought everything I need to sail away in a year with a finished book
links.link: Да, взял все необходимое чтобы через год уплыть отсюда с написанной книгой

passages.name: Да, взял все необходимое чтобы через год уплыть отсюда с написанной книгой
passages.text: mrred: Excellent! Let me show you your house.

passages.name: И это вам известно?
passages.text:
mrred: No secret — my agent looked into you before renting the house! You're fifty-six, a professor at an elite university, going through something like a creative crisis, and you need time alone.

mrred: This place is perfect for that. Let me show you your house.

passages.name: Давайте
passages.text: //after «let's go»: tutorial map — only the orange house

passages.name: orange house inside

links.name: That's what I need — a break from the phone
links.link: То что мне нужно, отдохну от телефона

passages.name: Это жутковато
То что мне нужно, отдохну от телефона
Понятно
passages.text:
mrred: You're polite! I like that.
mrred: Through our whole conversation you never asked why I have a red streak in my hair.

links.name: I thought it would be impolite to ask
I simply never had the chance

passages.name: Ну мне казалось это невежливым
passages.text:
mrred: I'll tell you anyway — it matters.
mrred: Every house on the island has its own colour — roof, walls, furniture. Besides privacy, we all value respect for personal matters. So instead of surnames we use colours. As you see, I'm Mister Red.
mrred: Many people underline it with their hair or clothes. You're free to do as you like — just try to respect others' space and don't pry.

passages.name: Просто не было возможности

passages.text:
mrblue: You mean Mister Red?
mrblue: All right, relax — I know it's hard to get used to; I'm not fully used to it myself, though I've lived here more than ten years.

passages.name: 10 лет?
passages.text: mrblue: Yes — hard to believe! I moved here when I turned sixty-seven. I decided to live for myself, and this place has everything I need.

passages.name: Да, я планирую написать книгу
passages.text: mrblue: Really? What kind of book? Scholarly? Or an adventure novel?

links.name: I want to write a scholarly book
I've wanted to write a novel for a long time

passages.name: Хочу написать научную книгу
passages.text: mrblue: Great — you'll have people to discuss it with, especially Miss Green; she loves books here. If you meet her, she'll surely ask to read the first chapters.

passages.name: Давно хочу написать роман
passages.text: mrblue: Well, scholarly books matter — someone reads them. I think you'll find people to talk to; especially Mister Black loves science here. If you meet him, he'll probably offer to review your book.

passages.name: Интересно
passages.text: mrblue: Well, don't be too curious. People don't like that here. Talking about science and books is always welcome. But I wouldn't try to bring up the past.

passages.name: А что вам нужно?
passages.text: mrblue: Sorry for being blunt, but that's none of your business. People don't like that here. Talking about science and books is always welcome. But I wouldn't try to bring up the past.
